The **Plans face** (`?opcv=plans`, beside Inbox in the op-chat sidebar) is the
owner's simplified plan tracker — a *status glance*, not the Create dock's
11-facet browser. Shipped by `owner-plans-single-pane-2026-07-17`.

## Where the pieces live

- **Face + list** — `apps/operator/app/_components/plans/PlansPane.tsx`. Active
  buckets only (`bucketOf ∈ draft/ready/running`), one search box, one "Finished"
  toggle. Rows carry a **needs-you** badge (distinct plans with a decision-tier
  `plans.attention` item — `usePlansNeedingYouCount`), a **live-agents** count
  (`advRoster.list` active entries' `currentPlanSlug`), item **progress**
  (`itemCounts`), and a **stale** chip (no activity ≥14d). Sorted needs-you desc,
  then recency. Pure helpers (`buildGlanceRows` / `progressOf` / `agoLabel` /
  `isStale`) are unit-tested.
- **Popup** — `PlanPopupModal.tsx`. A `Modal` wrapping the SAME `PlanDetail` the
  Create dock renders (4th mount context), **read-first**, with a dirty-edit
  close guard and a `.pc-plans__main` scroll wrapper (without it PlanDetail clips
  inside the modal — the dock's old clipping lesson). Tabs: **Plan | Sessions**
  on `?ppv`.
- **Sessions tab** — `PlanSessionsTab.tsx`. Lists every agent session that
  touched the plan, opens each in `SessionChatModal` (the chat-grade viewer, not
  the raw inspector), and plan-scopes the transcript search. "＋ Launch agent"
  is a plain plan-bound `launchAgent({ planSlug })` — no new kickoff kind.

## planSessions.list — plan → its agent sessions

The sync query `planSessions.list` (resolver in `sync-resolver/index.ts`, backed
by `listPlanSessions` in `packages/operator-core/lib/adv-sessions.ts`) answers
"which agents worked on this plan", with **two attribution legs** (D-005):

1. **primary** — `adv_sessions.plan_slug = $slug` (the launch binding);
2. **supplement** — plan-UNBOUND sessions (`plan_slug IS NULL`) of an agent that
   is `terminal_owner`/`taken_by` on a feature-family `work_items` row created
   from this plan (`source_plan_slug`). Catches an agent that claimed plan work
   but was launched without a plan binding. A session bound to a *different*
   plan is deliberately excluded, so it never misattributes.

Deduped `DISTINCT ON (coord_owner_id)` — one row per agent identity (the unit
`SessionChatModal` resolves owner → transcript from). Invalidated by any
`adv_sessions` write (`table-to-query-names.ts`), so the tab refreshes live.

## Plan-scoped transcript search — `?plan` via `filters.owners`

`GET /api/adv/sessions/search-transcripts` takes a `?plan=<slug>` param. It
resolves the plan's owner set (via `listPlanSessions`) and pushes it into the
shared search engine as **`filters.owners`** — the `session_turn` source ANDs
`owner = ANY(owners)` in both rankers.

**Why engine-level, not a post-filter:** the first cut filtered the engine's
top-N hits by session handle *after* ranking. For a common term (e.g.
"escalation") a plan's hits rank below the GLOBAL top-N and were all dropped →
0 results even though the plan's transcripts clearly contained the term. Pushing
the owner set into the engine makes the ranking happen *within* the plan's turns
from the start. If you scope a search to a subset, scope it in the ranker
(`filters.owners`), never after the cut.
